samples.summary: Design-doc section misdescribes the repo's actual preference pattern
samples.evidence: The new "Browser-Persisted Preferences" section claims display preferences "are read through a `useSyncExternalStore` hook rather than a React context" and that "The theme above is the oldest instance" — but `ThemeProvider` (packages/frontend/src/components/theme-provider.tsx) is precisely a React context, not a `useSyncExternalStore` store. It also states date format "is the second" localStorage preference while the tree already has several: `src/app/notes/notes-settings.ts` (viewMode/keymap), `src/app/board/board-grid.ts` (`wafflebase.board.grid`, grid-snap), `src/components/text-formatting/font-recents.ts`, and slides panel sizes in `slides-view.tsx`. The doc thus records a convention that the code does not follow and omits the existing instances it claims to enumerate.

samples.summary: Reimplements guarded localStorage read/write already present in at least four modules instead of extracting a shared helper
samples.evidence: `getDateFormat`/`setDateFormat` repeat the try/catch storage-access shape already implemented in `src/app/notes/notes-settings.ts:12-28`, `src/app/board/board-grid.ts:220-266`, `src/components/text-formatting/font-recents.ts:23-26`, and `src/api/analytics.ts:47-53`; the same diff adds a fifth and sixth copy (`readStoredTheme`/`writeStoredTheme` in theme-provider.tsx). Since the doc explicitly names this module "the reference shape for adding another one", a shared `safeStorage` util in `@/lib` would have been the reuse-consistent place for it.

samples.summary: Theme-provider storage hardening (plus its new test file) is unrelated scope in a date-format-preference change
samples.evidence: The diff adds `readStoredTheme`/`writeStoredTheme` guards and a whole new `tests/components/theme-provider.test.tsx` suite. This is a behavioral fix to the theme subsystem, independent of adding a date display format preference; it inflates the diff and couples an unrelated regression risk (every route is wrapped by ThemeProvider) to this feature.

samples.summary: Layering: the Settings route imports date formatters from the documents route module
samples.evidence: `import { formatExactDate, formatRelativeTime } from "@/app/documents/document-list-utils"` makes a cross-feature route dependency for what is now app-wide presentation logic. The preference store itself was correctly placed in `@/lib/date-format-preference.ts`; the matching formatters (`formatExactDate`, `formatFullDateTime`, `formatListDate`) arguably belong beside it in `@/lib` (note `@/lib/utils.ts:16` already exports a `formatRelativeTime`, so there are now two same-named formatters in two layers).

samples.summary: Storage key uses a third naming style
samples.evidence: `wafflebase-date-format` vs existing `wafflebase:notes:viewMode` (notes-settings.ts:9) and `wafflebase.board.grid` (board-grid.ts). No convention is enforced, but the new doc table presents this key as the reference shape.

samples.summary: DateCell uses a native `title` tooltip while the same file already uses the shadcn Tooltip primitives
samples.evidence: document-list.tsx imports Tooltip/TooltipTrigger/TooltipContent (lines 88-94) and uses them at line 870 for author avatars; the new date cell uses `title=` instead. Native `title` is used elsewhere in the file too, so this is a consistency preference only.

finding.summary: No design doc added or updated for the new user-preference subsystem. CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 and :56-58 require a feature / non-trivial change to write or update a doc under docs/design/ (fold into the canonical subsystem doc). This PR introduces a new persisted-preference store (`packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts`, storage key `wafflebase-date-format`, custom `wafflebase-date-format-change` event, `useSyncExternalStore` hook) plus a new Settings section, yet docs/design/frontend.md — which documents the analogous Theme System and its `"vite-ui-theme"` localStorage key at lines 534-545 — is untouched. Only docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-{todo,lessons}.md were added, and a task plan is not a design doc.
finding.evidence: docs/design/frontend.md "### Theme System ... Persists the user's choice in `localStorage` under \"vite-ui-theme\"" — no equivalent entry for the new date-format preference.

verdict.reason: The canonical frontend design doc *was* updated for this feature. `docs/design/frontend.md` contains a new "### Browser-Persisted Preferences" section (lines 551–587) immediately after the Theme System section, which names the new module `packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts` (line 557), tabulates the storage key `wafflebase-date-format` with its values and default (line 562), and documents the `useSyncExternalStore` snapshot contract, the custom `wafflebase-date-format-change` window event and why it is needed for the Settings page vs. documents list, the `subscribe()` cross-tab behavior, and the storage-access guards, plus a rule about what belongs in the backend instead. That is exactly what the finding says is absent, and it is folded into the canonical subsystem doc rather than being a parallel file — the design-doc discipline requirement in CONTRIBUTING.md is satisfied. The reviewer's claim that frontend.md is "untouched" and its greps ("preference|localStorage" in frontend.md → only line 539 theme) do not match the working tree; the same greps now return lines 551–575.
